title: nichy — show the first frame before the motion is ready
note: Entry #2 in her design heretics collection. A design-engineering tip for loading visual content: show the first frame before the motion is ready — for video, use a poster image until a frame is ready; for a JS composition, render its initial state in HTML, then let React take over. Why she keeps it: directly load-bearing for her own portfolio rebuild — every Play piece gets a poster frame before the motion takes over.
